explanation: Only fires at D2 of late-episode trials (from about trial 83 on, strongest at trials 88-99) where the agent chose a2, commonly reached S2, and the previous trial was unrewarded; it is about 8-10 when that unrewarded previous trial was a rare transition, only 0-3 when it was itself an unrewarded a2-to-S2 common trial, and about 3 near trial 83. It is 0 at every D1 and GO step, after a rewarded previous trial, on rare transitions, on a1 choices, and before roughly trial 80.
